description: This file defines the StudentAttendance class with methods for validating and setting attendance data, including date checks, student group validation, duplication checks, and holiday validation within the ERPNext education module.

classes.name: StudentAttendance
classes.description: Represents student attendance records with validation methods for date, student group, duplication, and holiday checks.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs all validation checks before saving the attendance record.

methods.name: set_date
methods.description: Sets the attendance date based on the course schedule.

methods.name: validate_mandatory
methods.description: Ensures either student group or course schedule is provided.

methods.name: validate_date
methods.description: Checks that the date is not in the future and within the academic year.

methods.name: set_student_group
methods.description: Assigns student group based on course schedule.

methods.name: validate_student
methods.description: Verifies the student belongs to the specified student group.

methods.name: validate_duplication
methods.description: Checks for existing attendance records to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: validate_is_holiday
methods.description: Ensures attendance is not marked on a holiday.
